Unpack **1.3.0** restores the original desktop UI.

## Downloads

- `Unpack_1.3.0_x64-setup.exe` — per-user installer. It does not need administrator rights. Windows SmartScreen may warn because the file is unsigned: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- `Unpack-portable.zip` — unzip anywhere and run `Unpack.exe`. Keep `WebView2Loader.dll` and `7za.exe` in the same folder.

WebView2 is already part of Windows 10 and 11.

## What’s new in 1.3.0

- Original dark chrome: top tools, destination bar, and “Drop an archive.”
- Library, Mod Menus, Homebrew Tools, Send to Xbox, Create archive, and Install DLC are overlay panels again
- Original Unpack mark (box and up-chevron)
- Archives extract into their own folder; existing names get a number; junk files can be skipped
- Auto ISO → GOD or XEX still uses the 1.1.1 multi-disc convert path

## Also in 1.2.0 / 1.1.1 / 1.1.0

- Discord Rich Presence
- Full Xbox 360 and original Xbox TitleID catalog (5,908 titles)
- Disc 1 and Disc 2 convert into one playable XEX folder, or one TitleID GOD set
- Send to Xbox skips `launch.ini` unless you opt in; LAN only

Use files you own. Back up `launch.ini` before you convert or copy anything. See `DISCLAIMER.txt`.
